edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the source address into transferFrom from transfer
msg.sender is the caller whose balance and allowance are checked and mutated in transferFrom
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize the arbitrary delegatecall
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize batchSend
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the full minted supply in the constructor
transfer unconditionally delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and addition
The allowance subtraction reaches an unchecked arithmetic operation enabling underflow
The balance subtraction reaches an unchecked arithmetic operation enabling underflow
approve writes the allowance mapping entry for msg.sender and _spender
delegate performs a delegatecall to attacker-influenced address with attacker-influenced calldata, executing arbitrary code in contract context
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath enabling overflow
batchSend mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and addition
The ensure modifier on transferFrom computes the UNI pair via pairFor
owner is read inside the ensure modifier to gate which parties may move tokens
owner is required to equal msg.sender before the delegatecall executes
owner is required to equal msg.sender before batchSend executes
The UNI constant feeds the pair address computation used by the ensure modifier

Destination argument is only consumed by transferFrom accounting
Amount argument directly feeds the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions

Amount argument is only written into the allowance mapping inside approve
Target address is the receiver of the low-level delegatecall
Calldata bytes are supplied directly to the low-level delegatecall
Array length participates in the unchecked multiplication for total
Amount participates in the unchecked multiplication for total
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked overflow-prone multiplication
Loop counter only drives the batchSend distribution loop
Per-iteration recipient only receives balance updates inside batchSend
Factory argument is only hashed into the derived pair address
Token argument is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor
Token argument is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor
Sorted token local only participates in the pair hash computation
Sorted token local only participates in the pair hash computation
Computed pair local is the return value of pairFor

Symbol argument is only assigned to the symbol state variable
